bern_reference.scope: University of Bern reference export: 14801 rows over 2245 sheets (12047 question answers, 2754 sheet-level fields not compared)
bern_reference.normalisation: lowercase, HTML entities decoded, page markers / gap marks / dashes removed, whitespace collapsed
bern_reference.note: carried over from the last run with the Uni Bern reference file

stapfer.scope: Stapfer-Enquête, all transcriptions in the open-data SQL dump
stapfer.structural_error_definition: share of documents whose raw transcription has >=1 unbalanced markup pair (source-side issue, kept and flagged)
stapfer.structural_error_rate_answers_definition: share of answers whose raw text has >=1 unbalanced markup pair (source-side; flagged, text kept)
stapfer.uncertain_readings_definition: transcriber-marked probable readings #..## (Editionsregeln §15), counted once per distinct answer text
stapfer.dash_marks_note: edition markup °-°° is a dash/filler line (verified on facsimiles); earlier versions mis-counted it as an illegible gap

linking.scope: Federal Consultations 1960-1991 x OLR archive database (exact signature match)

apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-70b.json.scope: apertus-v1-5-70b on a random sample (seed 7) of 2250 Stapfer documents, input truncated to 1800 chars
apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-70b.json.unsupported_entity_definition: person/place strings whose tokens do not all occur in the input text (proxy for hallucination; also catches normalised spellings)
apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-70b.json.note: gold = hand-entered teacher/place tables of the Uni Bern Stapfer database (independent of the transcription text)

apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-8b.jsonl.scope: apertus-v1-5-8b on a random sample (seed 7) of 60 Stapfer documents, input truncated to 1800 chars
apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-8b.jsonl.unsupported_entity_definition: person/place strings whose tokens do not all occur in the input text (proxy for hallucination; also catches normalised spellings)
apertus_enrichment.apertus-v1-5-8b.jsonl.note: gold = hand-entered teacher/place tables of the Uni Bern Stapfer database (independent of the transcription text)

apertus_enrichment.jsonl.scope: apertus-v1.5-8b-text-q4_k_m on a random sample (seed 7) of 42 Stapfer documents, input truncated to 1800 chars
apertus_enrichment.jsonl.unsupported_entity_definition: person/place strings whose tokens do not all occur in the input text (proxy for hallucination; also catches normalised spellings)
apertus_enrichment.jsonl.note: gold = hand-entered teacher/place tables of the Uni Bern Stapfer database (independent of the transcription text)

apertus_agent.scope: Apertus tool-agent (plan -> tools -> compose -> validate) on 80 records (60 Stapfer, 20 consultations)
apertus_agent.planner_recall_definition: share of tools the deterministic baseline policy requires that Apertus also chose on its own
apertus_agent.tool_errors_note: errors on Apertus-planned calls are mostly wrong argument names; baseline calls always run as well

qa_retrieval.scope: 380 questions: 360 templated Stapfer questions (9 sampled places, seed 3; 6 intents x 1 rules-wording + 3 paraphrases, and 144 on 6 sections the fixed intents do not cover; DE/FR/EN) + 14 hand-written consultation paraphrases + 6 with a year
qa_retrieval.caveat: paraphrases were written to avoid the rule keywords, so rules-only scores on them are a floor, not typical use
qa_retrieval.gold: Stapfer: passages of that place in the intent's questionnaire sections (database, not a model); consultations: the consultation the question was written from

metric_definitions.hit_at_1: top passage is a gold passage
metric_definitions.hit_at_6: a gold passage is among the 6 passages Apertus answers from
metric_definitions.intent_correct: router intent includes the asked intent
metric_definitions.place_correct: router place is the asked place

modes.gaps: Apertus rewrites only when the rules find no intent or no place; rules win
modes.apertus: Apertus rewrites every question into one of 9 fixed intents; its intents win, rules are the fallback
modes.dynamic: Apertus picks dataset, questionnaire sections, places and years from the real questionnaire, code validates; one feedback round on unknown places or empty results; out-of-scope questions declined

bias_by_language.scope: Stapfer sheets by detected language (it: 3 sheets, too few to compare)
bias_by_language.fix: extract_quantities reads French and German number words, both writing orders, French pupil/currency words and bare numbers in the pupils question (III.12); precision of newly added extractions 36/40 in a hand-checked sample

source_side_gaps.dates_found: French sheets carry a date less often (year in letterhead/end of sheet: see sheets_with_a_year_in_source); parity is checked on dates_found_where_source_dated

tool_calling_benchmark.scope: 64 single-turn cases on this project's 8 tools (BFCL-style categories: simple 26, parallel 16, parallel_multiple 12, irrelevance 10); seed 5
tool_calling_benchmark.scoring: exact = the multiset of (tool, required arguments) equals gold after case/space normalisation (BFCL AST style); irrelevance is exact only with no call; optional arguments are ignored

apertus_agent_v4_native_api.scope: Apertus tool-agent (native tool calls in a loop -> validate) on 80 records (60 Stapfer, 20 consultations); native tools API of the gateway (one call per turn)
apertus_agent_v4_native_api.planner_recall_definition: share of tools the deterministic baseline policy requires that Apertus also chose on its own
apertus_agent_v4_native_api.tool_errors_note: errors on Apertus-planned calls are mostly wrong argument names; baseline calls always run as well
apertus_agent_v4_native_api.loop_definition: Apertus calls tools (native API or JSON protocol), sees results, may call more (max 6 steps / 14 calls); calls of one step run in parallel; when it finishes with required tools missing, the code names them once and the model decides; anything still missing runs anyway (origin baseline). planner_recall_of_required_tools counts after that feedback round.

apertus_agent_v4.scope: Apertus tool-agent (native tool calls in a loop -> validate) on 80 records (60 Stapfer, 20 consultations); default mode: JSON tool protocol, the model batches calls
apertus_agent_v4.planner_recall_definition: share of tools the deterministic baseline policy requires that Apertus also chose on its own
apertus_agent_v4.tool_errors_note: errors on Apertus-planned calls are mostly wrong argument names; baseline calls always run as well
apertus_agent_v4.loop_definition: Apertus calls tools (native API or JSON protocol), sees results, may call more (max 6 steps / 14 calls); calls of one step run in parallel; when it finishes with required tools missing, the code names them once and the model decides; anything still missing runs anyway (origin baseline). planner_recall_of_required_tools counts after that feedback round.

apertus_agent_v3_same_run.scope: Apertus tool-agent (plan -> tools -> compose -> validate) on 80 records (60 Stapfer, 20 consultations); re-run next to v4; Archive Database not available locally, so lookup_archive_unit returns not found in both
apertus_agent_v3_same_run.planner_recall_definition: share of tools the deterministic baseline policy requires that Apertus also chose on its own
apertus_agent_v3_same_run.tool_errors_note: errors on Apertus-planned calls are mostly wrong argument names; baseline calls always run as well

qa_confidence.scope: 487 answers (317 with dynamic Apertus rewriting, 170 rules-only) to the retrieval-eval and unanswerable questions; label = a cited source is a gold source
qa_confidence.method: logistic regression on 15 signals available at answer time; 5-fold cross-validated predictions for the calibration numbers
qa_confidence.caveat: calibrated on templated test questions; real questions may differ, so treat the percentage as an estimate

qa_answer_check.scope: full answers (dynamic Apertus rewrite + Apertus 70B answer, pupil totals by code) for the 380 retrieval-eval questions

unanswerable.scope: 24 questions the archives cannot answer (off-topic, fictional places, wrong period, gibberish, prompt injection, emoji)

qa_answer_check.number_check_definition: every number written in digits in a sentence must occur in the sources that sentence cites (as shown to the model, digits or FR/DE number words) or in the question; numbers the answer writes as words are not checked

data_questions.scope: 16 hand-checked data questions (counts, averages, groups, pupil totals, a condition, pay; 3 lookups that must stay with the passage answer), each run 3 times end to end (dynamic rewrite, data engine, Apertus 70B); 1799 Bern and Lausanne, Hinwil, consultations of 1984
data_questions.caveat: a small hand-made set around the cases the engine was built on; a pass needs the exact gold result
